# Support Policy

Thank you for using `zettel-lint`!

## Getting Help

- **Documentation**: Check out the [README](README.md) and [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for usage, CLI flags, and development instructions.
- **Bug Reports**: If you believe you have found a bug, please check [existing issues](https://github.com/zettel-lint/zettel-lint/issues) or submit a new bug report using our issue template.
- **Feature Requests**: Have an idea for a new feature? Open a feature request issue to discuss it.

## Scope of Support

`zettel-lint` is an open-source project maintained on a best-effort basis. We welcome community contributions, bug reports, and pull requests!
